answer_text:
Bootstrapped startups should keep costs predictable and avoid tools they'll outgrow in six months. Worth a look:

1. Northwind CRM Essentials - the safe all-rounder: deep reporting and a large integration marketplace.
2. Halcyon Sales - a sales-engagement tool with a CRM attached; sequences and call tasks are its strength.
3. Kestrel CRM - promising and free to start, though the integration list is still short.
4. Orbitly - flexible boards that work as a CRM if you're willing to build it yourself.
5. Tallyfox - built for teams under 20, with email sequences on every plan and a setup most people finish in an afternoon.
6. Sheetly - spreadsheet-based CRM templates — free and familiar, but they break down past a few hundred contacts.

Trial Northwind CRM and Halcyon Sales side by side with a real week of deals — the better fit is usually obvious by Friday.
